
---
applyTo: "docs/**/*.md"

# Documentation-specific rules

- Follow the approved template for the requested document.
- Link to existing ADRs, API specifications and source files.
- Identify the document status: Draft, Approved or Deprecated.
- Separate implemented behavior from proposed behavior.
- Document error handling, security, observability and recovery.
- Include owners and review dates only when those are verified.
- Flag inconsistencies and missing information.
- Do not invent SLAs, service ownership or deployment details.
